name: buytracker-recipes
description: BuyTracker recipe service: per-store product-parse recipes from Workers AI, plus opt-in report intake

scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute buytracker-reports --remote --command "SELECT datetime(ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS at, version, url, read_price, read_availability, correct_price, correct_availability, note, outcome FROM feedback ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.usage: wrangler d1 execute buytracker-reports --remote --command "SELECT day, key, n FROM intake_counts WHERE key IN ('neurons:*', 'derive:*') ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 14"
scripts.errors: wrangler d1 execute buytracker-reports --remote --command "SELECT datetime(ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS at, version, context, name, message, browser FROM errors ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50"
